reviewer.tool: agent image read tool on the PNG files listed below

observations: The empty and model-surrounding backdrop is #1C1C1E on screen; it does not lighten with exposure or change with Neutral/ACES/Filmic.
Studio gray is neutral and custom #336699 keeps its hue behind the model and through glass transmission.

Ground highlight on shows a subtle local lift around the model base; off leaves the flat selected backdrop. The contact shadow remains visible with the highlight off, and turning shadows off while the highlight is on removes only the contact shadow.
The Settings panel shows Background and Ground highlight rows at 100%, 150% and 200% simulated DPI, in a narrow window, and under high contrast; labels and switches remain inside the panel.
Car windows retain their existing speckle/order defects on all three backdrops; no new halo surrounds the glass or body.
Camera lens remains dark with visible reflection/depth on dark and custom backdrops; its material appearance does not change with the backdrop.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Existing bright dotted windshield/side-glass speckles remain. T21a changes only the backdrop and ground treatment; coverage/transmission separation is still T22/T26/T27 work.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Roof/window interpenetration still reads as a single bright plate. Unchanged by T21a.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Tinted, rough and clear transmission still read similarly; T21a does not alter material shading.

defects.label: limitation
defects.description: The 150%/200% images use the Debug DPI test control (field 67) to relayout chrome in a 1280x860 physical client; they prove layout/reflow, not per-monitor rasterization on physical 150%/200% displays.
